description: # Overview This Power BI Custom Visual is an open‑source radar chart (also known as a spider chart) designed for presenting structured, category‑based data on a fixed scale. It visualizes category values on a 1–5 scale arranged radially, making it easy to compare strengths, weaknesses, and patterns across dimensions. At the center of the chart, the visual calculates and displays an overall index value, computed as the average of all category scores and scaled to a 0–100 range. The visual is fully open‑source under the MIT License, free of charge, and includes no telemetry, tracking, or external data connections. # Value Proposition This visual provides a clear and intuitive way to summarize multi‑dimensional assessments, especially when data comes from surveys, questionnaires, or scoring frameworks. Key benefits include: - Purpose‑built questionnaire visualization for fixed 1–5 rating scales. - Immediate insight through a central index summarizing overall performance. - Consistent and standardized presentation for structured scoring models. - Open‑source transparency and auditability. - Strict data containment: all processing stays inside Power BI. # Business Audience The visual is designed for analysts, report creators, and business teams working with structured scoring or survey data.
